headline: Rajesh Kumar Aggarwal files SEBI Takeover Disclosure under Regulation 31(4) for Insecticides (India) Limited
sum: Rajesh Kumar Aggarwal has submitted a mandatory disclosure under SEBI Takeover Regulations 2011, Regulation 31(4), signalling substantial share acquisition in Insecticides (India) Limited. The filing indicates a formal takeover-related disclosure to the NSE, triggering regulatory scrutiny under the substantial acquisition framework.
detail: Rajesh Kumar Aggarwal has filed a mandatory disclosure under SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011, Regulation 31(4), with the NSE on 3 July 2026. Regulation 31(4) requires disclosure of agreements for substantial acquisition of shares or voting rights, or acquisition of control, to the stock exchange. The filing indicates a material acquisition event in Insecticides (India) Limited, a listed agrochemical and pesticide manufacturer. The precise shareholding, consideration and full terms of the acquisition are contained in the detailed disclosure document filed with the exchange.
